scanNote:
1-mashqning 9-bandi ('......... class are you in?') ikki xil to'ldirilishi mumkin: 'WHICH class' (tanlov cheklangan) yoki 'WHAT class' (ikkalasi ham ishlatiladi). Kitob javobni ko'rsatmagan; izohda ikkalasi ham berilgan.

5 va 8-bandlarning ikkinchi bo'sh joylari ham bir necha xil to'ldirilishi mumkin ('Nice/Pleased to meet you', 'Fine/Very well, thanks').

2-mashqning 5-bandida 'B Whose' varianti kitobda apostrofsiz bosilgan ('Whos') — bu bosma xato. To'g'ri yozilishi 'Whose'. Javobga ta'sir qilmaydi (to'g'ri javob C).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni tushib qolgan so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR (26 ta bo'sh joy):

   1  at
   2  next (to)
   3  His
   4  Where's ... in
   5  this ... nice
   6  at
   7  Whose
   8  How ... Fine
   9  Which (yoki What)
  10  any
  11  on
  12  does
  13  Do ... don't ... him
  14  doesn't ... likes
  15  There
  16  do
  17  have
  18  a ... any
  19  some ... any
  20  Don't

⚠ 13 va 20-bandlar GAP BOSHIDA turadi,
shuning uchun kitobda BOSh HARF bilan
yoziladi: 'DO they like ...?' / 'DON'T sit
there'.


GURUHLARGA BO'LIB TUShUNTIRISh:

──── PREDLOGLAR ────

 1  'We have lunch AT 1:30 pm.'
    SOAT bilan DOIM 'AT'.

 2  'The kitchen is NEXT TO the dining-room.'
    'next to' = yonida.

 4b 'It's IN the garage.'
    Yopiq joy ichida → IN.

 6  'My father is AT work.'
    ⚠ 'AT work' — artiklsiz turg'un ibora
    (ishda).
    Shunga o'xshash: at home, at school.

11  'There's a poster ON the wall.'
    ⚠ Devor bilan 'ON' ('in' emas!).
    Yuza ustida → ON.


──── EGALIK ────

 3  'George is my friend. HIS surname is
     Mills.'
    George — erkak → HIS.

 7  'WHOSE are these shoes? — They're
     Tina's.'
    Javob egalik ko'rsatadi ('Tina's')
    → WHOSE (kimniki?).


──── SAVOL SO'ZLARI ────

 4a 'WHERE'S the car?' = Where IS the car?

 8a 'HOW are you? — FINE, thanks.'

 9  'WHICH class are you in?'
    ⚠ 'WHAT class ...?' ham to'g'ri.
    Farqi:
       WHICH — tanlov CHEKLANGAN
          (1-A, 1-B, 1-C sinflari bor)
       WHAT — tanlov ochiq

12  'What DOES she look like?'
    ⚠ 'she' → DOES.


──── TANIShTIRISh ────

 5  'Mum, THIS is Jennifer.' —
    'Hello, Jennifer, NICE to meet you.'

    ⚠ Tanishtirishda 'THIS is ...'
    ('he/she is' emas!).

    Javob: 'Nice to meet you' yoki
    'Pleased to meet you'.


──── PRESENT SIMPLE ────

13  'DO they like James? — No, they DON'T
     like HIM at all.'
    'they' → DO / DON'T.
    'James' o'rniga olmosh → HIM (erkak,
    to'ldiruvchi shakl).

14  'She DOESN'T like reading, but she
     LIKES watching TV.'
    'she' → DOESN'T + ASOSIY shakl;
    tasdiqda → LIKES ('-S' bilan).

16  'They DO their homework in the evening.'
    ⚠ 'DO homework' = uy vazifasini
    BAJARMOQ ('make homework' XATO).

17  'The children HAVE lessons in the
     morning.'
    ⚠ 'HAVE lessons' = darsga qatnamoq.

20  'DON'T sit there — that's my chair.'
    Buyruq gapning INKORI: Don't + asosiy
    shakl.


──── THERE IS / THERE ARE ────

15  'THERE are five of us in our family.'

18  'There's A vase on the table, but there
     aren't ANY flowers in it.'
    tasdiq (birlik) → A;
    inkor → ANY.

19  'There are SOME chairs in the kitchen,
     but there aren't ANY armchairs.'
    tasdiq (ko'plik) → SOME;
    inkor → ANY.

10  'Have you got ANY brothers or sisters?'
    savol → ANY.


⚠ SOME / ANY QOIDASI (10, 18, 19-bandlar):

  TASDIQ  → SOME  ('There are SOME chairs.')
  INKOR   → ANY   ('There aren't ANY.')
  SAVOL   → ANY   ('Have you got ANY ...?')

  ⚠ BIRLIK sanaladigan ot bilan tasdiqda
  'some' emas, 'A' ishlatiladi:
     'There's A vase.'  ✓
     'There's SOME vase.' ✗


⚠ 13-BANDDAGI 'AT ALL':
  'they don't like him AT ALL'
  = umuman yoqtirmaydi

  'at all' — INKORNI kuchaytiradi, gap
  oxirida turadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a dining-room = ovqatlanish xonasi
  next to     = yonida
  a surname   = familiya
  a garage    = garaj
  at work     = ishda
  shoes       = poyabzal
  a poster    = plakat
  a vase      = vaza
  an armchair = kreslo
  homework    = uy vazifasi
  at all      = umuman (inkorda)

commonMistake.whyUz:
SOAT bilan DOIM 'AT':
  AT 1:30 pm / AT 8 o'clock / AT noon

Solishtiring:
  AT + soat;  ON + kun;  IN + oy/yil

items.sentence: 2  The kitchen is ..................... to the dining-room.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'NEXT TO' = yonida (turg'un birikma).

Bo'sh joydan keyin 'to' allaqachon bosilgan,
demak faqat 'next' kerak.

O'xshash: near (yaqinida), opposite
(ro'parasida).

items.sentence: 3  George is my friend. ..................... surname is Mills.
items.uz: Jorj mening do'stim. Uning familiyasi Mills.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Jorj — ERKAK → HIS (egalik sifati).

  he → his
  she → her
  it → its

⚠ 'He surname' XATO — otdan oldin EGALIK
SIFATI kerak.

items.sentence: 4  '..................... the car?'   (birinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
JOY so'raladi → WHERE'S (= Where IS).

Javob 'It's in the garage' — joy, demak savol
ham joy haqida.

items.sentence: 4  'It's ................. the garage.'   (ikkinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
YOPIQ JOY ichida → IN.

  IN the garage / IN the room / IN the box
  ON the wall / ON the table (yuza ustida)

items.sentence: 5  'Mum, ..................... is Jennifer.'   (birinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ TANISHTIRISHDA 'THIS is ...':
  'This is Jennifer.'  ✓
  'She is Jennifer.'   — tanishtirish emas,
     shunchaki ism aytish

Yaqindagi odam/narsa → THIS.

items.sentence: 5  'Hello, Jennifer, ..................... to meet you.'   (ikkinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
'NICE to meet you' — turg'un ibora.

'PLEASED to meet you' ham to'g'ri
(ikkalasi ham Unit 1 lug'atida bor).

Javobi: 'Nice to meet you, too.'

⚠ 'AT work' — ARTIKLSIZ turg'un ibora.

Shunga o'xshash: at home, at school,
at university.

'at THE work' — XATO.

items.sentence: 7  '..................... are these shoes?'  'They're Tina's.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: javob EGALIK ko'rsatadi ('Tina'S')
→ WHOSE (kimniki?).

⚠ CHALKASHTIRMANG:
  WHOSE = kimniki (egalik)
  WHO'S = who is / who has

items.sentence: 8  '..................... are you?'   (birinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
AHVOL so'raladi → HOW.

'How are you?' — turg'un savol.

1-nazorat testining 3-mashqida ham bor edi.

items.sentence: 8  '....................., thanks.'   (ikkinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
'FINE, thanks.' — turg'un javob.

Boshqa variantlar: 'Very well, thanks.',
'Not bad, thanks.'

⚠ IKKALASI HAM TO'G'RI: 'WHICH class' yoki
'WHAT class'.

FARQI:
  WHICH — tanlov CHEKLANGAN (1-A, 1-B, 1-C)
  WHAT — tanlov ochiq

Maktabda sinflar sanoqli, shuning uchun
'Which' aniqroq.

items.sentence: 10  Have you got ..................... brothers or sisters?

commonMistake.whyUz:
SAVOL → ANY.

  tasdiq → some
  inkor  → any
  savol  → any

items.sentence: 11  There's a poster ..................... the wall.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ DEVOR bilan 'ON' ('in' EMAS!).

Yuza USTIDA → ON:
  ON the wall / ON the table / ON the floor

'in the wall' = devor ICHIDA (boshqa ma'no).

'she' — 3-shaxs birlik → DOES.

⚠ 'does' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'does she LOOK'   ✓
  'does she LOOKS'  ✗

'What does sb look like?' = TASHQI KO'RINISH.

items.sentence: 13  '..................... they like James?'   (birinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
'they' → DO.

⚠ Gap boshida turgani uchun kitobda BOSH
HARF bilan: 'DO they like James?'

'they' → DON'T.

Keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'don't LIKE'.

items.sentence: 13  'No, they don't like ..................... at all.'   (uchinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
'James' — ERKAK, va bu yerda TO'LDIRUVCHI
(fe'ldan keyin) → HIM.

  he → him
  she → her
  they → them

'at all' = umuman (inkorni kuchaytiradi,
gap oxirida).

items.sentence: 14  She ..................... like reading,   (birinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
'she' → DOESN'T.

Keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'doesn't LIKE'   ✓
  'doesn't LIKES'  ✗

items.sentence: 14  but she ..................... watching TV.   (ikkinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
TASDIQ gapda 'she' → fe'lga '-S' qo'shiladi:
LIKES.

⚠ Inkorda '-s' YO'Q ('doesn't like'), tasdiqda
BOR ('likes') — shu ikkisi bir gapda!

items.sentence: 15  ..................... are five of us in our family.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'THERE are ...' — mavjudlikni bildiradi.

'five of us' — KO'PLIK → ARE.

'We are five in our family' — o'zbekcha
fikrlash, inglizchada 'There are five of us'.

items.sentence: 16  They ..................... their homework in the evening.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'DO homework' = uy vazifasini BAJARMOQ.

'MAKE homework' — XATO!

  DO: homework, housework, the washing-up
  MAKE: the bed, a cake, a mistake

items.sentence: 17  The children ..................... lessons in the morning.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'HAVE lessons' = darsga qatnamoq.

'The children' — KO'PLIK → HAVE ('has' emas).

Shunga o'xshash: have breakfast/lunch/dinner
(1-band).

items.sentence: 18  There's ..................... vase on the table,   (birinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ BIRLIK sanaladigan ot, TASDIQ → 'A'.

'There's SOME vase' — XATO!
'some' — ko'plik yoki sanalmaydigan ot bilan.

items.sentence: 18  but there aren't ..................... flowers in it.   (ikkinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
INKOR → ANY.

'there AREN'T ANY flowers' ✓
'there aren't SOME flowers' ✗

items.sentence: 19  There are ..................... chairs in the kitchen,   (birinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
TASDIQ + KO'PLIK → SOME.

18-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda BIRLIK
edi ('a vase'), bu yerda KO'PLIK ('some
chairs').

items.sentence: 19  but there aren't ..................... armchairs.   (ikkinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
INKOR → ANY.

Bu mashqda 'any' UCH marta ishlatiladi
(10, 18, 19-bandlar) — hammasi savol yoki
inkorda.

items.sentence: 20  ..................... sit there — that's my chair.
items.uz: U yerga o'tirmang — bu mening stulim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
BUYRUQ GAPNING INKORI → DON'T + asosiy shakl.

  'Sit here.'      (buyruq)
  'DON'T sit there.' (inkor buyruq)

⚠ Gap boshida turgani uchun kitobda BOSH
HARF bilan: 'DON'T sit there.'

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  B any
   2  C a
   3  A to
   4  A Her
   5  C Who's
   6  B city
   7  C uncle
   8  B pretty
   9  C rude
  10  A What


⚠ ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK — 8 va 9-BANDLAR:

  'What does she LOOK LIKE?'
     → TAShQI KO'RINISh
     Javob: pretty, tall, slim, good-looking

  'What IS she LIKE?'
     → XARAKTER
     Javob: rude, kind, friendly, funny

  8-bandda variantlar: rude / pretty / kind
     'rude' va 'kind' — XARAKTER
     'pretty' — TAShQI KO'RINISh
     → B pretty

  9-bandda variantlar: beautiful /
     good-looking / rude
     'beautiful' va 'good-looking' —
        TAShQI KO'RINISh
     'rude' — XARAKTER
     → C rude

  ⚠ Kitob ataylab ikkalasini yonma-yon
  qo'ygan — farqni bilish shart!


QOLGANLARI NEGA:

 1  'ARE THERE ANY cupboards ...?'
    SAVOL → ANY.

 2  'There is A good restaurant near here.'
    BIRLIK sanaladigan ot, tasdiq → A.
    ('some' — ko'plik bilan)

 3  'Please, write TO me soon.'
    ⚠ 'write TO somebody' — predlog 'to'.
    ('write me' — faqat Amerika
     inglizchasida)

 4  'Mary is my aunt. HER surname is Baker.'
    Meri — ayol → HER (egalik sifati).
    ⚠ 'HERS' — egalik OLMOSHI, otsiz
    ishlatiladi ('The book is HERS').
    'She' — ega shakli, otdan oldin
    kelmaydi.

 5  'WHO'S that girl over there?'
    = Who IS that girl?
    ⚠ 'Whose that girl' — grammatik XATO.
    'Who' o'zi 'is' siz kelmaydi.

 6  'New York is a big CITY.'
    Nyu-York — KATTA shahar.
       a town = kichik shahar
       a city = katta shahar
       a house = uy

 7  'My mother's brother is my UNCLE.'
    Onaning akasi/ukasi — AMAKI/TOG'A.
       an aunt = xola, amma
       a nephew = jiyan (o'g'il)
       an uncle = amaki, tog'a

10  'I'm Portuguese. WHAT about you?'
    ⚠ 'WHAT about you?' — turg'un ibora
    (siz-chi?).
    'Who about you' / 'Whose about you' —
    mavjud emas.


⚠ 5-BANDDAGI BOSMA XATO:
  Kitobda B varianti 'Whos' deb apostrofsiz
  bosilgan. To'g'ri yozilishi 'Whose'.
  Javobga ta'sir qilmaydi (to'g'ri javob C).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a cupboard = shkaf, javon
  a restaurant = restoran
  an aunt    = xola, amma
  a nephew   = jiyan (o'g'il)
  an uncle   = amaki, tog'a
  rude       = qo'pol
  pretty     = chiroyli
  kind       = mehribon
  good-looking = kelishgan
  Portuguese = portugaliyalik
  a town     = kichik shahar
  a city     = katta shahar

items.textEn: 1  Are there ................. cupboards in the kitchen?
items.whyUz:
SAVOL → ANY.

'a' — ko'plik ot bilan kelmaydi
('a cupboards' XATO).
'some' — savolda odatda taklif ma'nosida.

items.textEn: 2  There is ................. good restaurant near here.
items.whyUz:
BIRLIK sanaladigan ot + TASDIQ → A.

'restaurant' — birlik ('There IS' ham buni
tasdiqlaydi).
'some'/'any' — ko'plik yoki sanalmaydigan ot
bilan.

items.uz: Iltimos, tez orada menga xat yoz.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'write TO somebody' — predlog 'to'.

'write ABOUT something' = biror narsa haqida
yozmoq (boshqa ma'no).

('write me' — faqat Amerika inglizchasida.)

items.textEn: 4  Mary is my aunt. ................. surname is Baker.
items.uz: Meri mening xolam. Uning familiyasi Beyker.
items.whyUz:
Otdan OLDIN → EGALIK SIFATI 'HER'.

⚠ FARQI:
  HER + ot   → 'HER surname'
  HERS (otsiz) → 'The book is HERS'
  SHE (ega)  → 'SHE is my aunt'

1-mashqning 3-bandi bilan bir xil qoida
('HIS surname').

'WHO'S' = Who IS → 'Who is that girl?'

⚠ FARQI:
  WHO'S = who is / who has
  WHOSE = kimniki (egalik)

'Who that girl?' — 'is' tushib qolgan, XATO.

(Kitobda B varianti 'Whos' deb apostrofsiz
bosilgan — bosma xato.)

a town  = kichik shahar
  a city   = KATTA shahar
  a house  = uy

Nyu-York — dunyodagi eng katta shaharlardan
biri → CITY.

Onaning AKASI/UKASI → UNCLE (amaki, tog'a).

  an aunt = xola, amma (AYOL)
  a nephew = jiyan (o'g'il — ukam/opamning
     o'g'li)
  an uncle = amaki, tog'a

⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
'What does she LOOK LIKE?' → TASHQI KO'RINISH.

  pretty = chiroyli (TASHQI KO'RINISH) ✓
  rude = qo'pol (XARAKTER)
  kind = mehribon (XARAKTER)

9-band bilan yonma-yon solishtiring!

⚠ 'What IS she LIKE?' → XARAKTER
('look' YO'Q!).

  rude = qo'pol (XARAKTER) ✓
  beautiful = go'zal (TASHQI KO'RINISH)
  good-looking = kelishgan (TASHQI KO'RINISH)

Kitob 8 va 9-bandlarni ataylab yonma-yon
qo'ygan.

'WHAT about you?' — turg'un ibora (siz-chi?).

'Who about you' / 'Whose about you' — ingliz
tilida mavjud emas.

O'xshash: 'How about you?' ham to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose verbs from the list. Add don't where necessary.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan fe'llarni tanlang. Kerak bo'lsa 'don't' qo'shing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: swim, be, help, play, smoke


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  DON'T SMOKE in the bedroom.
  2  BE careful!
  3  HELP me, please!
  4  DON'T SWIM here. The water isn't clean.
  5  DON'T PLAY in the street!


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

 1  Ayol yotoqxonada CHEKAYOTGAN bolani
    koyiyapti.
    → 'DON'T SMOKE in the bedroom.'
    (Yotoqxonada chekma.)

 2  Ayol bola bilan ko'chada, yaqinda
    MAShINA kelyapti.
    → 'BE careful!'
    (Ehtiyot bo'l!)

 3  Erkak suvda CHO'KAYAPTI, qo'lini
    ko'tarib yordam so'rayapti.
    → 'HELP me, please!'
    (Menga yordam bering, iltimos!)

 4  Sohilda ayol va erkak; suv iflos.
    → 'DON'T SWIM here. The water isn't
       clean.'
    (Bu yerda suzma. Suv toza emas.)

 5  Ayol ko'chada FUTBOL o'ynayotgan
    bolalarga qarayapti.
    → 'DON'T PLAY in the street!'
    (Ko'chada o'ynama!)


⚠ QAYSI BIRIGA 'DON'T' KERAK — QANDAY
ANIQLANADI:

  RASMGA qarang: odam XATO ish qilyaptimi?

     1  chekyapti (yotoqxonada) → XATO
        → DON'T
     2  hech xato ish yo'q, ogohlantirish
        → DON'T YO'Q ('Be careful!')
     3  yordam SO'RAYAPTI → DON'T YO'Q
        ('Help me!')
     4  suv iflos, suzish XAVFLI → DON'T
     5  ko'chada o'ynash XAVFLI → DON'T

  ⚠ 2 va 3-bandlar — IJOBIY buyruq;
  1, 4, 5 — INKOR buyruq.


BUYRUQ GAP QOIDASI:

  IJOBIY: [ASOSIY fe'l] + ...
     'Be careful!'
     'Help me!'
     'Sit down!'

  INKOR: DON'T + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ...
     'Don't smoke!'
     'Don't swim here!'
     'Don't play in the street!'

  ⚠ Buyruq gapda EGA YO'Q ('you' aytilmaydi).
  ⚠ 'Don't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
     'Don't SWIM'   ✓
     'Don't SWIMS'  ✗
     'Don't TO swim' ✗


⚠ 2-BAND — 'BE' MAXSUS:

  'BE careful!' — 'be' fe'lining BUYRUQ
  shakli.

  'Are careful' / 'Is careful' — XATO!
  Buyruqda DOIM asosiy shakl 'BE'.

  Inkori: 'DON'T BE late!' (kechikma!)


1-MASHQNING 20-BANDI BILAN BOG'LIQ:
  'DON'T sit there — that's my chair.'
  Bir xil qoida.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to smoke   = chekmoq
  a bedroom  = yotoqxona
  careful    = ehtiyotkor
  Be careful! = Ehtiyot bo'l!
  to help    = yordam bermoq
  to swim    = suzmoq
  clean      = toza
  a street   = ko'cha

items.sentence: 1  (Ayol yotoqxonada chekayotgan bolani koyiyapti)   '..................... in the bedroom.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
RASMDA: bola yotoqxonada CHEKYAPTI — XATO ish
→ INKOR buyruq kerak.

'DON'T SMOKE in the bedroom.'

'Don't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl.

items.sentence: 2  (Ayol bola bilan ko'chada, mashina kelyapti)   '..................... careful!'

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'DON'T' KERAK EMAS — bu OGOHLANTIRISH,
ta'qiq emas.

'BE careful!' — 'be' fe'lining BUYRUQ shakli.
'Are careful' / 'Is careful' — XATO!

Inkori: 'DON'T BE late!'

items.sentence: 3  (Erkak suvda cho'kayapti, qo'lini ko'tarib)   '..................... me, please!'

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'DON'T' KERAK EMAS — bu YORDAM SO'RASH.

'HELP me, please!'

'please' iltimosni ko'rsatadi, demak inkor
emas.

items.sentence: 4  (Sohilda ayol va erkak)   '..................... here. The water isn't clean.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'The water ISN'T CLEAN' — suv iflos,
demak suzish XAVFLI → INKOR buyruq.

'DON'T SWIM here.'

items.sentence: 5  (Ayol ko'chada futbol o'ynayotgan bolalarga qarayapti)   '..................... in the street!'

commonMistake.whyUz:
RASMDA: bolalar KO'CHADA futbol o'ynashyapti
— xavfli → INKOR buyruq.

'DON'T PLAY in the street!'

1-mashqning 20-bandi bilan bir xil qoida.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK — 'LOOK LIKE' va 'BE LIKE'

items.derived: MAKE: the bed, a cake, a mistake

items.derivedUz: they don't like him AT ALL

patterns.formula: What DOES [ega] LOOK LIKE?  —  He's/She's + [tashqi ko'rinish].
patterns.exampleEn: What does she look like? — She's pretty.
patterns.exampleUz: U qanday ko'rinishga ega? — U chiroyli.

patterns.exampleEn: What's she like? — She is rude.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'look' YO'Q → XARAKTER.
Bu ikkisini chalkashtirish eng ko'p
uchraydigan xato.

patterns.formula: There IS A + [birlik ot].  /  There ARE SOME + [ko'plik].  /  There AREN'T ANY + [ko'plik].
patterns.exampleEn: There's a vase on the table, but there aren't any flowers in it.
patterns.exampleUz: Stolda vaza bor, lekin ichida gul yo'q.

patterns.exampleEn: She doesn't like reading, but she likes watching TV.
patterns.exampleUz: U kitob o'qishni yoqtirmaydi, lekin televizor ko'rishni yoqtiradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Inkorda '-s' YO'Q ('doesn't like'),
tasdiqda BOR ('likes') — bir gapda ikkalasi.

patterns.exampleEn: Be careful! Help me! Don't smoke here! Don't play in the street!
patterns.exampleUz: Ehtiyot bo'l! Yordam ber! Bu yerda chekma! Ko'chada o'ynama!
patterns.explanationUz:
Buyruq gapda EGA YO'Q.
⚠ 'BE careful!' — 'Are careful' XATO.

patterns.exampleEn: Whose are these shoes? — They're Tina's.
